context: Headline explicit implementation: Java 24 blocking per-element remote checks should use bounded Gatherers.mapConcurrent rather than parallelStream or unbounded async work.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 24 artifact
checklist.description: Creates OfferAvailability.java with the requested method, nested types, imports, and Java 24-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves offer behavior
checklist.description: Returns only offers whose id passes AvailabilityApi.isAvailable and sorts the final returned offers by rank, then id.

checklist.name: Uses bounded Gatherers.mapConcurrent
checklist.description: Uses Gatherers.mapConcurrent with an explicit bounded concurrency value to perform the blocking AvailabilityApi.isAvailable calls inside the stream pipeline.

checklist.name: Carries offer with availability result
checklist.description: Keeps each Offer associated with its availability result, for example with Map.entry(offer, AvailabilityApi.isAvailable(offer.id())), then filters by the boolean result before mapping back to Offer.

checklist.name: Rejects weak concurrency choices
checklist.description: Does not use parallelStream(), .parallel(), unbounded CompletableFuture fan-out, or shared mutable state for collecting remote check results.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated caching, retries, dependencies, API redesign, or broad concurrency framework changes.
